.list_finish                        \ A = y; list_type, list_x: entry X's rectangle
{
    SEC                             \ y1 = y - 2 (or 0)
    SBC #2
    BCC y_low
    STA list_y1,X
    LDY list_type
    ADC mover_types_height_table,Y  \ C set: y - 2 + height + 1
    BCS y2_top
    ADC #3                          \ y2 = y + height + 2 (or &FF)
    BCC y2_ok
    BCS y2_top                      \ always
.y_low                              \ y < 2: A = y - 2 + 256, C clear
    ADC #2                          \ A = y, C set
    STZ list_y1,X                   \ 65C02 opcode
    LDY list_type
    ADC mover_types_height_table,Y  \ y + height + 1
    BCS y2_top
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    BNE y2_ok                       \ wrapped to 0: y + height + 2 = 256
.y2_top
    LDA #&FF
    CLC
.y2_ok
    STA list_y2,X                   \ C clear on every path
    LDA list_x_lo                   \ x1 = x - 1
    SBC #0                          \ (C clear: the - 1)
    STA list_x1_lo,X
    LDA list_x_hi
    SBC #0
candidates.new:
JSR world_of_address
    LDX list_n
    LDA wa_y                        \ list_finish's work, reading wa_x where it is: no copy to list_x
    SEC                             \ y1 = y - 2
    SBC #2
    BCC lv1_cold                    \ y < 2: list_finish
    STA list_y1,X
    LDY list_type
    ADC mover_types_height_table,Y  \ C set: y - 2 + height + 1
    BCS lv1_cold
    ADC #3                          \ y2 = y + height + 2
    BCS lv1_cold                    \ 256 or more: list_finish (C clear below)
    STA list_y2,X
    LDA wa_x_lo                     \ x1 = x - 1
    SBC #0                          \ (C clear: the - 1)
    STA list_x1_lo,X
    LDA wa_x_hi
    SBC #0
    STA list_x1_hi,X
    LDA wa_x_lo                     \ x2 = x + width + 1
    SEC                             \ (the +1)
    ADC mover_types_width_table,Y
    STA list_x2_lo,X
    LDA wa_x_hi
    ADC #0
    STA list_x2_hi,X
    RTS
.fin1_ylow                          \ list_finish's cold paths, out of its way
    ADC #2                          \ y < 2: A = y, C set
    STZ list_y1,X                   \ 65C02 opcode
    LDY list_type
    ADC mover_types_height_table,Y  \ y + height + 1
    BCS fin1_top
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    BNE list_finish.fin1_ok         \ wrapped to 0: y + height + 2 = 256
.fin1_top
    LDA #&FF
    CLC
    BRA list_finish.fin1_ok         \ 65C02 opcode
.lv1_cold                           \ y near either end of its range: list_finish does it
    LDA wa_x_lo
    STA list_x_lo
    LDA wa_x_hi
    STA list_x_hi
    LDA wa_y
}
.list_finish                        \ A = y; list_type, list_x: entry X's rectangle
{
    SEC                             \ y1 = y - 2 (or 0)
    SBC #2
    BCC list_live.fin1_ylow
    STA list_y1,X
    LDY list_type
    ADC mover_types_height_table,Y  \ C set: y - 2 + height + 1
    BCS list_live.fin1_top
    ADC #3                          \ y2 = y + height + 2 (or &FF)
    BCS list_live.fin1_top
.fin1_ok
    STA list_y2,X                   \ C clear on every path
    LDA list_x_lo                   \ x1 = x - 1
    SBC #0                          \ (C clear: the - 1)
    STA list_x1_lo,X
    LDA list_x_hi
    SBC #0
candidates.summary: list_live computes its rectangle in place: reads wa_x/wa_y directly (no copy to list_x_lo/hi, 12 cycles), hot path falls through with no taken branch; y<2 or y2 overflow (never in the profile) copies and falls into list_finish. list_finish's two cold paths are moved ahead of it (inside list_live's scope) so its hot path also has no taken branch (BCC y2_ok 3 cycles -> BCS 2). Alternative to candidate 2 (same live path, plus the list_finish relayout). Measured in a scratch build of the bench image: render 23430 -> 23388 a pass (seed 1, 1500 passes), 28406 -> 28365 (RIGHT, 600 passes); passlock 2000 passes: state and screen identical.
candidates.equivalence: list_live: the hot path computes list_y1/y2/x1/x2 exactly as list_finish does from the same wa_x_lo/hi, wa_y, list_type, X = list_n and Y = list_type (the SEC/SBC/ADC chain is the original's, C clear at the x1 SBC #0 because the second BCS was not taken). Any y<2 (BCC) or overflow of y2 (either BCS) goes to lv1_cold, which does the original's copies (list_x_lo/hi = wa_x) and reloads A = wa_y with X untouched, then falls into list_finish, which recomputes every field from scratch (the early STA list_y1,X is overwritten). list_x_lo/hi are read only by list_finish (grep src and tools: no other reader); list_recorded still sets them before its JMP list_finish, so that path is unchanged. No caller uses A, X, Y or flags after list_live (close_over_overlaps does INC list_n; widen_by_live does PLX and re-sets Y). The list_finish rewrite: BCC y_low -> BCC fin1_ylow (same condition), BCS y2_top -> BCS fin1_top, the pair 'BCC y2_ok / BCS y2_top' becomes 'BCS fin1_top' falling into fin1_ok (same: C clear -> ok); fin1_ylow's body is y_low's verbatim (BNE to fin1_ok, BCS to fin1_top, falling into fin1_top = LDA #&FF, CLC, BRA fin1_ok). Every path reaches fin1_ok with C clear as before.
candidates.relies_on: Nothing else reads list_x_lo/list_x_hi (list_recorded writes them before JMP list_finish); world_of_address leaves wa_x_lo/hi/wa_y valid and X free; list_finish is entered only by list_live's fall-through (now via lv1_cold) and list_recorded's JMP (grep: one JMP at render.6502:1151). Labels fin1_ylow, fin1_top, lv1_cold, list_finish.fin1_ok unique (Baron scope-qualified references list_live.fin1_ylow/fin1_top and list_finish.fin1_ok assemble). Page crossings: grows bank 4 code by 55 bytes (widen_by_live $98EE -> $9925, list_overlap $9948 -> $997F, everything after slides 55); the new hot path has no taken branch and no indexed read that crosses (mover_types_*_table is HAZEL data, unmoved). Measured with pcprof on the bench build: the slide cost nothing net (render -42 a pass seed 1, -41 RIGHT, interrupts/logic unchanged).
